observed_difference.assessment: The accessible digital witnesses differ at this word. This establishes a witness-level variant for review only; it does not establish which form is earlier, authorial, or preferable, and does not authorize normalizing either stored text.

attribution_boundary.named_authority: Qurtubi names al-Jawhari after the lexical cluster with حكى جميعه الجوهري; within the cluster, the cistern-spout sense is specifically reported from Abu Ubayd.
attribution_boundary.poem_voice: Qurtubi's text marks the line as recited but does not name its poet here. The al-Sihah witness places it after its Abu Ubayd report. This note does not infer a new transmission route or independently verify the poem's historical attribution.
attribution_boundary.preserve: Retain the live Qurtubi wording as a witness, retain the al-Sihah wording as a separate witness, and keep the Q10B English omission visible.
